subject: Invoice batching cutoff, split remittance, and VAT evidence for August cycle
messages:
From: Anna Torres <accounts@novisupply.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Novis Supply AP <ap@novisupply.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: August invoicing — batch cutoff + VAT evidence needs

Hi Soojin,

Quick one ahead of the August bill run. Our AP team has two requests before we close the month:

1) Can Redwood split the August charges into two payments? We need the EU portion (for our EU entity) to be wired separately to a local account to avoid cross-border fees.
2) We also need a PDF copy of VAT evidence (VAT registration + tax point) for the invoice line items that are billed to our EU entity. Ideally that evidence is attached to the invoice or included in the same delivery channel.

We prefer invoices delivered into our billing portal, but if the portal cannot carry VAT attachments or handle split remits, we’re happy to accept an emailed PDF. Can you confirm cutoff time for the invoice batch and the simplest delivery path for the VAT certs?

Best,
Anna
Accounts Payable, Novis Supply
attachments: none

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Anna Torres <accounts@novisupply.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: August invoicing — batch cutoff + VAT evidence needs

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up. Short answer: we can support both split remits and VAT evidence, but there are two slightly different workflows depending on what you want to prioritize (automation vs. attachment fidelity).

Options:
- Portal-first (recommended if you want one source-of-truth): We can push the invoice PDF into your portal record and attach VAT evidence PDFs there. The portal supports per-invoice attachments and a remittance field but currently does not natively split bank remits into two outgoing transfers — you would receive a single PDF with clear payment instructions for two wires. AP would then initiate two outgoing wires. Cutoff for the August batch is 18:00 UTC on Aug 6 to guarantee inclusion in the run.

- Email + split remits (recommended if you need our team to control the split remittance text precisely): We can send the invoice and separate VAT evidence PDFs by email as a secure bundle, and include explicit wiring instructions for the EU account. If you want the invoice to be split into two separate invoice numbers (one for EU entity, one for non-EU), we’ll need a legal/billing contact confirmation and a PO mapping by EOD Aug 4 so our finance system can generate two invoice records before the batch. Cutoff for split-invoice creation is EOD Aug 4 (23:59 UTC).

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm which workflow you prefer (Portal with attachments vs Email + split invoices).
2) If you choose split invoices, send the PO mapping and legal entity name for the EU remit (exact billing name and VAT number) by end of day Aug 4.
3) If Portal, confirm the portal account ID so we can attach the VAT PDFs directly.

I’ve looped in Ben (billing ops) and Kim (enterprise onboarding) to coordinate the PO mapping and attachment transfer.

Cheers,
Soojin
Senior Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 415-555-0127
